abstract: Testicular seminomas occur in various forms of which the classical, the spermatocytic, and that with syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells are distinctly defined. Anaplastic seminomas, however, are less clearly distinguished. Forty-five seminomas, 39 pure and 6 combined tumors, were examined from the perspective of the current definition that 3 or more mitoses per high power field (m/hpf) distinguish the anaplastic from the classical form. Our resultant yield of over 80% of "anaplastic" seminomas is clearly incompatible with general clinical experience, indicating that the arbitrary criterion of 3 m/hpf does not segregate anaplastic forms from neoplasms that are mitotically active but relatively non-aggressive. Moreover, the evidence indicates that mitotic activity does not adequately define a tumor form that is near the undifferentiated end of the spectrum which extends from "embryonal carcinoma" to the spermatocytic type. If it should prove, however, that the mitotic rate must be used as an arbitrary watershed criterion until a more reliable one is found, it should then be set at more than 5 m/hpf, yielding a percentage of anaplastic seminomas (about 9%) that is compatible with clinical experience.
abstract_ja: 精巣セミノーマは、古典型、精子細胞型、合胞栄養膜巨細胞を伴う型など、いくつかの形態で存在し、そのうち古典型、精子細胞型、合胞栄養膜巨細胞型は明確に定義されている。しかし未分化型セミノーマは明確な区別が難しい。45例のセミノーマ（純粋型39例、混合型6例）を、未分化型を古典型と区別する現行定義（高倍率視野あたり3個以上の有糸分裂）に照らして検討した。その結果、「未分化型」が80%以上を占め、これは臨床経験と明らかに矛盾する。このことは、任意に設定された3個/高倍率視野という基準が、有糸分裂活性は高いが比較的非攻撃的な腫瘍を未分化型から区別できないことを示している。さらに、有糸分裂活性は、胎児性癌から精子細胞型に至るスペクトラムの未分化側の端にある腫瘍の型を十分に定義できないことも示唆される。有糸分裂数を任意の境界基準として使わざるを得ない場合は、より信頼できる基準が見つかるまで、5個/高倍率視野を超える値に設定すべきである。そうすれば、臨床経験と整合する未分化型セミノーマの割合（約9%）が得られる。
